[n] (if (= n 0) true  (odd2? (dec n))))\n             (odd2?  [n] (if (= n 0) false (even2? (dec n))))]\n       (even2? 10))\n\n   Why not `let` + `fn`: a `let` binding cannot see its own name, let alone a\n   sibling declared later, so a recursive local written with `let` fails with\n   an unbound-var error at call time.
